Official Guidelines for Benefit Claims Eligibility

I. Introduction

The Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA) hereby establishes the following
comprehensive guidelines for determining eligibility for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance
Program (SNAP). These criteria have been meticulously developed to ensure that nutritional
support is provided to those state residents who demonstrate a genuine need for assistance.


II. Income Eligibility Thresholds

A. Households without Earned Income

The following table delineates the maximum allowable gross monthly income for households

| Household Size | Maximum Monthly Gross Income | Maximum Annual Gross Income |
|----------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|
| 1 person       | $1,950                       | $23,400                     |
| 2 people       | $2,650                       | $31,800                     |
| 3 people       | $3,350                       | $40,200                     |
| 4 people       | $4,050                       | $48,600                     |
| 5 people       | $4,750                       | $57,000                     |
